# The Far Side of the Bell

*Mirabel wants a second pair of ears: stand on the far side of the Great Bell at dusk, when the wind is kind, then ask Fulke whether he heard anything over his own lute.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Mirabel](../npcs/mirabel.md) |
| Level | 13 |
| After | [Ribbons for Dusk](../quests/mirabel_ribbons_for_dusk.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the far side of the Bell in [Royal Plaza](../maps/selsior.md)
2. Talk to [Fulke](../npcs/fulke.md)

## Rewards

- 380 EXP
- 260 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x10
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +110 standing with [Mirabel](../npcs/mirabel.md)
